unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-PREP YEAR-LEVEL: A2 - THEME 7: LIFE IN NATURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will design and write a project based on their experiences and imagination of daily activities in nature, extreme weather conditions, and adventures in nature. They will describe the roles people play in different outdoor activities, how weather conditions influence those activities, and the necessary preparations for adventures in nature. Students will write scripts for each role and act out different scenarios involving nature-based activities like hiking, camping, or experiencing extreme weather conditions. The assignment will be evaluated using rubrics. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in nature with its components such as daily activities in nature, extreme weather conditions and adventures in nature'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in the preparatory year of an upper secondary school may know what daily activities in nature, extreme weather conditions and adventures in nature mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in another language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in the preparatory year of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in nature'' in English from previous themes and/or years such as ''an earthquake, a flood and so on'' and also some structures such as ''I was walking in the forest when it started to rain. They saw a bear while they were fishing. You should take an umbrella.'' in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in the preparatory year of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''daily activities in nature, extreme weather conditions and adventures in nature'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To describe past actions and events to create a story by using the target vocabulary and the target grammar. Activity 1: Complete the Story The teacher explains that students complete an unfinished story about a nature adventure using target vocabulary and grammar. Students receive the beginning of a story, such as: ''It was a sunny day, and we were walking in the forest. The birds were singing, and everything was peaceful. Suddenly, we heard a strange noise behind the trees…''. In pairs, students brainstorm ideas and write the continuation of the story, using simple sentences with the target grammar. Then, each pair reads their story to the class, focusing on fluency and storytelling. The teacher provides feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and creativity. Finally, students vote for the most creative and enjoyable story. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To describe what people were doing in nature in the past in English by using the target vocabulary and the target grammar. Activity 1: Picture Story The teacher tells the students that they do an activity where they describe what people were doing in nature in the past. The teacher provides a set of pictures depicting scenes such as someone hiking, a bird flying, or a child planting a tree. Students work in pairs to write sentences describing what was happening in each picture, such as ''She was planting a tree in the garden'', or ''The bird was flying over the lake''. After completing their sentences, students take turns reading them aloud to the class while focusing on clear pronunciation. The teacher provides constructive feedback on their grammar and pronunciation to help them improve. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
